title: Unbreakable Will
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Unbreakable Will · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1483209176

← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Steadfast

Tier 1Cost 1

You move with the certainty of one who’s already lived through the ambush—nothing takes you unawares. You cannot be surprised while conscious.

Full original wording

You move with the certainty of one who’s already lived through the ambush—nothing takes you unawares. You cannot be surprised while conscious.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per short rest, reduce damage from a single attack by your proficiency bonus × 2.

Full original wording

A breath away from ruin, you twist free—damage that should have ended you grazes past like a whisper. Once per short rest, reduce damage from a single attack by your proficiency bonus × 2.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, when you would be reduced to 0 HP, you instead remain at 1 HP and are immune to being stunned, paralyzed, and all damage until the end of your next turn

Full original wording

When death reaches for you, you wrestle back control, holding your breath in the space between worlds. Once per long rest, when you would be reduced to 0 HP, you instead remain at 1 HP and are immune to being stunned, paralyzed, and all damage until the end of your next turn

Theme 2

The Iron Mind

Tier 1Cost 1

Gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

Full original wording

You hold your emotions like a steady flame, steady and unwavering despite the chaos around you. Gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

Tier 2Cost 2

Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, or advantage on Wisdom saves if you’re already proficient.

Full original wording

Your consciousness is a fortress, impervious to intrusion, manipulation, or possession. Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, or advantage on Wisdom saves if you’re already proficient.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per short rest, automatically succeed on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw or check if combat related.

Full original wording

No puzzle or mystery can stand before the sharpness of your intellect and the depth of your insight. Once per short rest, automatically succeed on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw or check if combat related.

Theme 3

The Resolute Defender

Tier 1Cost 1

Once per turn, when you take physical damage, you can reduce it by your Strength + your Con mod. This is any damage accompanying bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

Full original wording

Pain strikes deep, but you shrug it off, carved from tougher stuff than flesh and bone. Once per turn, when you take physical damage, you can reduce it by your Strength + your Con mod. This is any damage accompanying bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing.

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per round, whenever you succeed on a saving throw against a harmful effect from an enemy you can spend a hit die to heal your max hit die roll + your con mod. This takes place after taking the damage. Necrotic damage prevents this until the beginning of your next turn.

Full original wording

You embrace agony as a catalyst, a dark gift that mends and empowers your flesh and spirit. Once per round, whenever you succeed on a saving throw against a harmful effect from an enemy you can spend a hit die to heal your max hit die roll + your con mod. This takes place after taking the damage. Necrotic damage prevents this until the beginning of your next turn.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per long rest, you can choose to automatically roll 20 on a death saving throw.

Full original wording

You have stared into the abyss and returned, untouched and unstoppable. Once per long rest, you can choose to automatically roll 20 on a death saving throw.
